name: Stone of Adventure
description:
About This Game

In Stone of Advenutre we take a classic roguelike deckbuilder (like Slay the Spire), featuring animated card battles, and blend it with tactical, procedurally generated hexagonal maps where you can interact with obstacles. The result is a dynamic fusion that generates tens of thousands of unique combat scenarios!

Features:

  • Usable obstacles! - Break bridges to trap enemies, hurl stones for ranged attacks, or snack on berries for instant buffs during battle—and that's just the start of over 50 interactive elements!

  • Procedural Generation: Maps feature varied height differences, randomized obstacle placements, and enemy positions, leading to diverse battle types like ambushes, escorts, and escapes. This creates an endlessly replayable experience with fresh challenges every run!

  • Explore Amazing Worlds: Venture through four distinct biomes, each with its own themes and secrets! Collect rare cards, powerful artifacts, and recruit unexpected allies while completing quests—from straightforward errands to epic boss trials. Every expedition delivers new strategies and memorable moments!
short_desc: Fuse CCGs, roguelikes, and hex-grid tactics. Scavenge cards & artifacts. Master the interactive battlefield: topple trees onto foes and shove them off cliffs. Your clashes bridge shattered worlds to avert catastrophe. Forge your path home!
